name: LiteLLM AI Gateway
short_desc: Central AI providers, workspace keys and usage tracking
author: BerriAI
description: A personal AI gateway with a web dashboard for provider credentials, model aliases, virtual keys and usage tracking. Connect OMP in Coder workspaces using gateway keys instead of distributing OpenRouter or Requesty credentials. Includes a private PostgreSQL database.

form_fields.label: Dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Choose a strong password for the admin dashboard. Provider credentials are added there after installation.

form_fields.label: Gateway master key material
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically; the actual master key is sk- followed by this value. Keep it on the server and issue virtual keys for workspaces.

form_fields.label: Provider encryption key
form_fields.hint: Back up with the database. Do not change it: stored provider credentials would become unreadable.

form_fields.label: Database password
form_fields.hint: Generated for database initialization on first boot. Changing it later does not change the database password and will prevent the gateway from connecting.
